title: Weeping Willow
body:
Description

Weeping Willow is an exclusive tree released in the Halloween 2023, 2024 and as well as the Halloween 2025 event. They spawn all around Finlay, but spawn in a large abundance near Mythril Forest/Junkyard.

Weeping Willow is the most common of the 3 new trees released. This can be sold for candy, the currency for this event, which can be used to purchase Halloween items at The Monstrous Manor and presents at other locations.

This is the tree with the most branches (It’s really troublesome to go to the background.)
